pivot_note: pivot: pixels from the PNG's top-left; model_xy: where the pivot sits at rest (model units, feet at y 0)

fiery_hat.desc: the Fiery Hat: a tall red top hat with a black band; pivot at the brim's middle, set on Jerry's top in front of his fuse cap

fiery_hat_flames_0.desc: the hat's paper flames, frame 0: alternate the two every 4 to 6 frames; pivot at their foot, on the crown's top (0, 13)

fiery_hat_flames_1.desc: the hat's paper flames, frame 1: alternate the two every 4 to 6 frames; pivot at their foot, on the crown's top (0, 13)

chandelier.desc: the chandelier: a gold frame of two tiers of curved arms, eight candles, crystal drops; pivot at the top ring, where the chain hooks on (it falls from there)

chain.desc: four chain links, 8 units; stack copies up to the ceiling, pivot at the bottom link

crystal_shard_0.desc: a crystal shard for the crash: throw them out spinning; pivot at its middle

crystal_shard_1.desc: a crystal shard for the crash: throw them out spinning; pivot at its middle

crystal_shard_2.desc: a crystal shard for the crash: throw them out spinning; pivot at its middle
